race.comment: ANOTHER BRIDE (4) races for the first time in 27 weeks. Strung together a win and two minor placings at this track early last prep before the form deteriorated. Has looked good in trials/jump outs recently so a positive first-up run is anticipated. SOLAR GAZE (2) returns from a six-month spell. Was beaten narrowly twice in March over this course and distance before a poor run at Oakbank put an end to the campaign. Finished second in a recent Strathalbyn jump-out which suggests he is forward enough to run well. EQUINE HEADLINE (5) is back after a seven-month spell and looking to break a drought of around three years. Closed the last campaign with two minor placings here, the latest at this distance. Always a threat around this circuit. IN YOUR WORDS (7) resumes off a 24-week spell. Blinkers go on straight away which can be construed as a positive sign from the Tootell camp.  PRESCIENT (1) has been in the frame at four of five first-up runs so keep him in mind at the first run back.
